card.text: Red giant 11.26 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Arcturus is a red giant 11.26 parsecs away, about 25 times the Sun’s radius. Interferometers have measured its disc; here its surface is a plain sphere.

sources.label: Lacour et al. 2008
sources.locator: Table of limb-darkening fits, quadratic law

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of a measured spectrum of the star, from the ground. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.
